name: Auto-Relaxed Sphere Tracing
aliases: Automatic Step Size Relaxation in Sphere Tracing
definition: A robust sphere tracing method that automatically scales step sizes based on data from previous iterations, using a scalar hyperparameter similar to the learning rate of gradient descent methods.
summary: Auto-Relaxed Sphere Tracing is a robust ray-marching method that adapts step sizes using a scalar hyperparameter, reducing invalid steps and fallback needs compared to uniform tracing.
